summary_ru: Импульс PA6 записан целиком: LOW 18696 мкс, оба фронта и участок после возврата HIGH. Разрешение 1 мкс.
trace_reference: 1-us DMA sample grid relative to Break IRQ publication; IRQ latency is not an electrical-edge timestamp
limitations: Pulses shorter than 1 us may be missed; edge positions are quantized to the sample grid
First event since boot; STOP/CLEAR do not overwrite it
Only PA6/SD is measured; width alone cannot uniquely identify overcurrent, driver undervoltage, or interference
